function.description: Preview a cross-chain bridge WITHOUT executing - routes, pricing, fees, and ETA. Use this when the user asks what moving an amount between two chains would cost or how long it would take, and before every BridgeExecute: the execute is authorized only by a fresh matching quote on the SAME provider, within 15 minutes and with identical params. Venue comes from Khalani's live chain registry: Khalani when it serves both sides, Relay otherwise, which is how Robinhood Chain routes. Resolve fromToken and toToken separately with TokenFind on their exact chains. For an EVM token, call TokenFind with exactly one target chain and continue only when mutationReady is true. Ambiguous, provider-capped, or metadata-unreadable results are not executable identities. If the swap pair is already known, prefer its exact base or quote token address and use TokenFind to validate that address on the target chain. TokenFind reads symbol and decimals from the contract, never provider list metadata. Read decimals from a contract-verified TokenFind candidate on the exact source chain. A provider-list decimal is not signing authority, and a raw amount without contract decimals is unsafe. `amountRaw` is in RAW base units (wei/lamports), matching the underlying bridge quote. Read-only, and the quoted output is already net of Vex's 25 bps input-token fee. RETURNS `tokenMetadata` with `source`, `destination`, `amountRaw`, and nullable `amountHuman`; each EVM side is contract/registry verified or `kind: metadata_unavailable`, which blocks signing. RETURNS, on the Khalani route, quoteId, routeCount, routes (each routeId, type, amountIn, amountOut, etaSeconds and its expiry fields), vexFee and expiryNote. On the Relay route it returns a summary, serviceable, fromChain/toChain, fromToken/toToken, amounts (in and out, each with token, amountRaw, human amount and a nullable usd estimate), vexFee, estimatedTimeSeconds, minimumAmountOutRaw, totalImpactPercent, appliedSlippagePercent, steps and requestId. `vexFee` is a union: the fee amount and receiver fields exist only when it is actually charged.
function.name: BridgeQuote

amountRaw.description: Amount in raw atomic units of fromToken (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000"). Read decimals from a contract-verified TokenFind candidate on the exact source chain. A provider-list decimal is not signing authority, and a raw amount without contract decimals is unsafe.
